notes.title: ¡A Major New Update Has Just Arrived!
notes.content:
Hello pilots
Before we start, we would like to apologize for the state of the game's release, with multiple bugs, design flaws and so on, in this new update we have listened to them and solved most of those bugs, mechanics and so on, especially the issue of Optimization in the gameplay was improved

Here's a full list of the changes in the update

1.- Improved render distance for better movement on the map
2.- Increased the number of bullets on pallet (this varies depending on your PC)
3.- Optimized RAM usage
4.- Bugs with adaptive music have been resolved
5.- Changed the SFX of all items, enemies, and more
6.- Added UI changes for better game immersion
7.- Dynamic Difficulty Optimization
8.- New songs were added to the repertoire
9.- New Visual Effects
10.- and more bugs fixed

Again we want to apologize, we continue to work hard to keep this game working and to be able to bring more video games, we hope they give us a new opportunity and we hope to see them on the battlefield. !Thank you!

GameWorks Interactive Team

notes.title: Shaped Beats, Now Available for Linux
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41359303/023aacd1c121b3da5c8865910df30c3e09d6d3e1.png[/img]

Shaped Beats, It is now available for all Linux platforms, in addition to that, patches were added to correct game errors.

We are anticipating that we will bring one more update, in a few days, which will include 2 new battles, we will not spoil anything, since it is a surprise.

for now we tell you about the new addition and the applied patches.

1.- More content was added to the tutorial.
2.- the infinite health bug was patched
3.- Nerfed the number of upgrade chips you get when shooting enemies
3.- 3 songs were changed from the original ost.
4.-problems with dolby 7.1 audio were fixed
5.- Loading times were optimized.
6.- The waiting time after the improvements was optimized.
7.- the armor obtained by the scorestreaks was nerfed

Thanks For Keeping Supporting This Great Game, We Will Keep Updating This Game Constantly, We Love To Hear From The Community, So Feel Free To Leave Your Suggestions.
Greetings to all the pilots

notes.title: Version 3.0 is here! Look What's New In This Version
notes.content:
[h1]Hello All Pilots.[/h1]

[h2]We are sorry for the delay in the release of the new update and patch 3.0.
This Decision Was Made To Further Polish The New Mechanics, And Implementations That We Made In This New Update, As Well As The Correction Of Errors Found In The Course, This Update Fixes Most Of The Errors Of The Previous Versions (Including Some Things that were made on purpose), In addition to Implementing Visual Improvements, More Detailed Pixel Arts And Others, We Leave You The Complete List Of What Is Implemented In This Update[/h2]

[h2][b]Implementation of New Mechanics: [/b][/h2]
[h3]-Auto/manual trigger
-Auto/Manual Alternate Trigger
-Dynamic Difficulty
-New Temporary Damage Effects
-Critical Damage Chance
-Hit Box Visible (It's smaller than it looks)
-More Battlefield View[/h3]

[h2]Audiovisual Improvements:[/h2]
[h3]-Implementation of Pixel Perfect Camera 2D
-Dolby Atmos 7.1 Audio Implementation
-Optimization Of Objects, Enemies and bullets On Screen.
-Compatibility with AMD Freesync
-Detailed and Remastered Sprites
-Song Remastering[/h3]

[h2]Extra Implementations:[/h2]
[h3]-New Tutorial Added
-New Boss Added
-New Intro Added
-Insta Kill enemies
-New Balancing Of Enemies and Player[/h3]

[b]Note: In case of finding any error, report it through Steam, WhatsApp or Email to solve it immediately[/b]

[b] WhatsApp: 317 136 2793 (Support Available In Spanish, English,)
Mail: supportgameworksstudio@gmail.com (Support Available In All Languages)[/b]

[h3] Thank you very much for the support, opinions and others, we will continue to constantly update this video game, greetings to the pilots and future pilots.[/h3]

[b]Atte: GameWorks Studio Latam[/b]

notes.title: ¡Important! This Monday, The New Update Arrives
notes.content:
Hi Pilots.
We are aware that there are still problems within the video game
rest assured that we have resolved 90% of the bugs found.
In addition to that, we notify you that we have added new content to the game, that will improve the gameplay and optimization of the game.
now, let's clear something up.
Many people think that we are a group of 10 programmers, the answer is NO.
We are not many people, we are a studio of only 2 people.
we are dedicating ourselves %100 to our project.
Thank you very much for all the support, reviews and others, this Monday, the new version 3.0.0.2022 will be available.
We will not give spoilers
wait for it

notes.title: ¡The Gunsmith Enhancements Came To Shaped Beats!
notes.content:
[h1][b]The Gunsmith Is Here To Help You In Your Battle For Truth And Justice In Shaped Beats[/b][/h1]

[h3]Get Enough Chips To Upgrade Your Ship With New Weapons
Get Up To 6 Master Chips To Get A New Upgrade[/h3]

5 New Improvements Were Implemented

1.- [i][b]Percussion Ammunition[/b][/i]: Increases Damage of Main Bullets

2.- [i][b]Laser Gun[/b][/i]: Fires 2 Extra Armor Piercing Projectiles.

3.- [i][b]Spike Shoots[/b][/i]: Shoot 4 Spiked Spheres that pierce through enemies (Only Shoot In X)

4.-[i][b]Spread Shoot[/b][/i]: Fires 2 High Power Projectiles, Go Through Armor Layers, Usually Bounce Off Each Other

5.- [i][b]ShootGun Ammunation[/b][/i]: Fire 5 Small Pellets in a 180 Degree Radius

New Controls Added

Use The [b]"K"[/b] Button To Fire Your Primary Weapon Along With The Upgrades (You Can Also Use [b]"J" [/b]But Only For The Primary Fire)

The pause menu was edited and the errors that the previous version presented were corrected.

Finally

To Move Between Pause and Enhancement Menu Use:

[b]"A":[/b] Change Menu Left
[b]"D"[/b]: Shift Menu Right

[b]"Left Arrow"[/b]: Move In The Enhancements And Options Menu
[b]"Right Arrow"[/b]: Move In The Enhancements And Options Menu

We will continue to give constant updates to the video game.
Thanks for your support

Good Hunting For The New And Veterans Of This Video Game
